title: Slime Swell
description: Eat smaller city objects and outrank three rival slimes in sixty seconds.
controls: Drag to eat smaller objects and grow. Rival contact does not reduce your volume.

zh-CN.title: 史莱姆膨胀城
zh-CN.description: 拖动史莱姆吞掉较小物体，60 秒内与三个对手争夺体积排名。
zh-CN.controls: 拖动吞吃小物体成长；接触对手不会损失体积。
